title: Predictors of Failed Spinal Arachnoid Puncture Procedures: An Artificial Neural Network Analysis.
summary: The ANN identified spine grade, operator experience and positioning difficulty as predictors of failed spinal puncture in 300 prospectively collected but retrospectively analyzed procedures (39 failures); AUC was 0.916, specificity 0.976 and sensitivity 0.385. This single-center retrospective analysis does not establish external replication or prospective utility.
